system.description:
You treat the Wan-Shen as a Medium Weapon instead of a Large Weapon. You can use the Pin and Trip feats with a Wan-Shen, substituting your attack bonus with the Wan-Shen for your Grapple check. You must have your Wan-Shen in hand to use this Talent.

In addition, when you use the Wan-Shen as a Double Weapon, you reduce all attack penalties for attacking with both ends of the weapon by 1.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Jedi Academy Training Manual
